The plan you see is a simulation, so no money has actually been paid or approved (F1). It shows that you would pay USD 990.00 to the food supplier on 2026-11-10, with a USD 10.00 discount applied (F3). Your modeled net benefit from the plan is USD 3.70, which comes from the discount gained minus the cost of paying early (USD 6.30) (F4). To cover the payment you would need to reserve USD 990.00 from your verified funds (F5). The plan still requires you to accept the offer and authorize the payment before anything could move forward (F6).
